clips.title: The story
paras: Dust devils roam Westfall, and Collin Mauren needs their remains for a spell. The Mage Quarter wizard is helping Gaxim Rustfizzle with an unusual experiment. Their work calls for a messaging scroll, and the dust holds what Mauren needs to enchant it.

Collin Mauren is preparing a messaging scroll for Gaxim Rustfizzle. The wizard is helping the tinkerer with an unusual venture, but the spell needs more than ink and vellum. Dust devils roam Westfall with elemental magic swirling within them. Their remains provide the volatile medium Mauren needs to bind Gaxim's spell to parchment.

Westfall was once Stormwind's fertile breadbasket. Drought, banditry, and neglect have left its fields arid and wild. Dust devils roam there, threatening travelers and lone homesteaders. Their residue holds the focused elemental essence Mauren needs to complete the enchantment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, I think I have it. A messaging spell... I believe that's the effect he's looking for.
I'll have to create a scroll with the spell impressed upon it. To do that I'll need debris from a dust devil.

While I gather the rest of the components, why don't you head to Westfall and find one of the foul creatures? They are dangerous, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle if you're willing to subject yourself to one of Gaxim's experiments.
I'll be here when you return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Have you found the component I need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.
